facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psdisptev:.sbss
facts.value: Represents either a concrete cached particle TEV-mode key or an invalid sentinel. Equality with the next masked request is a cache hit that suppresses all GX programming; a different key transitions the cache to the requested mode and installs its recipe. Invalidation transitions it unconditionally to UINT32_MAX, deferring hardware-state restoration until the next setup request.
